@lemma_F : ∀ {P : Type u_3} {Q : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq P] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Q] [inst_2 : Fintype P]
  [inst_3 : Fintype Q] (r : P → Q → Prop) [Nonempty P] (η γ d : ℝ),
  Fintype.card P = Fintype.card Q →
    0 < γ →
      γ ≤ 1 →
        η ≤ γ ^ 2 / 8 →
          16 / γ ^ 2 ≤ d →
            (∀ (v : P ⊕ Q), (1 - η) * d ≤ ↑((bipGraph r).degree v) ∧ ↑((bipGraph r).degree v) ≤ d) →
              (∀ (Z : Finset (P ⊕ Q)), Z.Nonempty → #Z ≤ Fintype.card P → γ * d * ↑(#Z) ≤ ↑(cutCount (bipGraph r) Z)) →
                ∃ F ≤ bipGraph r,
                  F.IsRegularOfDegree (roundedDegree η γ d) ∧
                    (1 - 3 * γ / 8) * d - 1 ≤ ↑(roundedDegree η γ d) ∧
                      ∀ (Z : Finset (P ⊕ Q)),
                        #Z ≤ Fintype.card P → γ / 2 * ↑(roundedDegree η γ d) * ↑(#Z) ≤ ↑(cutCount F Z)

@lemma_F_of_balanced_partition : ∀ {P : Type u_4} {Q : Type u_5} {V : Type u_6} [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq Q]
  [inst : DecidableEq V] [inst_1 : Fintype P] [inst_2 : Fintype Q] [inst_3 : Fintype V] (r : P → Q → Prop) [Nonempty P]
  (H : SimpleGraph V) (e : P ⊕ Q ≃ V),
  (∀ (a b : P ⊕ Q), H.Adj (e a) (e b) ↔ (bipGraph r).Adj a b) →
    ∀ (η γ d : ℝ),
      Fintype.card P = Fintype.card Q →
        0 < γ →
          γ ≤ 1 →
            η ≤ γ ^ 2 / 8 →
              16 / γ ^ 2 ≤ d →
                (∀ (v : V), (1 - η) * d ≤ ↑(H.degree v) ∧ ↑(H.degree v) ≤ d) →
                  (∀ (Z : Finset V), Z.Nonempty → 2 * #Z ≤ Fintype.card V → γ * d * ↑(#Z) ≤ ↑(cutCount H Z)) →
                    ∃ F ≤ H,
                      F.IsRegularOfDegree (roundedDegree η γ d) ∧
                        (1 - 3 * γ / 8) * d - 1 ≤ ↑(roundedDegree η γ d) ∧
                          ∀ (Z : Finset V),
                            2 * #Z ≤ Fintype.card V → γ / 2 * ↑(roundedDegree η γ d) * ↑(#Z) ≤ ↑(cutCount F Z)

scientific_scope.nominal_degree_parameter: real d, so integer source case included
scientific_scope.parameters: 0<gamma<=1, eta<=gamma^2/8, d>=16/gamma^2; eta>=0 derived from nonempty degree interval
scientific_scope.factor_degree: Nat.floor ((1-eta-(eta+2/d)/gamma)*d); floor argument nonnegative, agrees with integer floor

limitations: This is the known factor/flow consequence in the written Lemma F, not a proof of the entire sampling/router/Hamiltonicity BM pipeline.
The gamma/2 bound is for sets up to half the vertices; it is not asserted for the BJ two-thirds range.
